start.text: Onii-chan! You're finally home. I missed you so much!

choices.text: Hey, Yui. I missed you too.
I'm tired. Maybe later.
You're always so clingy.

warm.text: Hehe! I made dinner. Well, I tried. It's a bit burnt, but I tried!

choices.text: I'm sure it's great. Let's eat together.
You don't have to cook for me, Yui.

cold.text: Oh... okay. I'll leave you alone then. Sorry for bothering you.

choices.text: Wait, I didn't mean it. Come here.
Thanks.

tease.text: Clingy? I'm not clingy! I just... love my big brother. Is that so wrong?

choices.text: No, it's not wrong. I love you too, Yui.
It's a bit much sometimes.

dinner.text: Yay! Okay, sit down. I'll bring it. ...You know, I really like living with you. It feels like... home.

choices.text: It is home, Yui. Always.
Me too. You're the best sister.

independent.text: But I want to! Taking care of you is... it's what makes me happy. Is that weird?

choices.text: It's not weird. It's sweet.
A little, but I appreciate it.

close.text: Onii-chan... can I ask you something? It's kind of embarrassing...

choices.text: Of course. You can tell me anything.
Sure, what is it?

confession.text: Lately... I've been having these dreams. About you. They're not... sisterly dreams. I don't know what to do.

choices.text: Dreams are just dreams, Yui. Don't worry about it.
What kind of dreams?
That's... not appropriate, Yui.

reassure.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said anything. Forget it.

choices.text: I didn't say it's wrong. Just... let's talk about it.
Okay. Forgotten. (She looks disappointed)

curious.text: I... I dream about you touching me. Holding me. Like a... lover. It scares me. But it also feels... right?

choices.text: Yui, that's not right. You're my sister.
Feelings are feelings. They don't have to make sense.
Do you want me to make those dreams real?

shame.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I don't know what's wrong with me...

choices.text: Nothing is wrong with you. I'm just surprised.
We should forget this happened.
Never. You're my little sister. I love you.
Let's just take it slow.

accept.text: Onii-chan... I'm so relieved. I've been so scared to tell you. Can we... try? Just once?

choices.text: Yes. Come here.
Not yet. But I won't push you away.

tempt.text: You... you'd really do that? For me? I... yes. Yes, I want that. I want you.

choices.text: (Take her hand)
